limitations.cpu_scope: container cgroup aggregate; includes all processes in cgroup
limitations.memory_peak_scope: cgroup-lifetime high-water mark; may predate sampling
limitations.network_scope: proc self network namespace; not container isolated with host networking

telemetry.scope: CURRENT_CONTAINER_ONLY; distributed executors require per-host monitor

limitations.heartbeat: cumulative updates retained as per-task maxima and excluded from totals to avoid double counting
limitations.task_metrics: summed once from unique TaskEnd events; a stage metric is null if any task did not report it
